content:
Latin America iGaming, Payments & FX Overview (H1 2026 )
🇨🇱 Chile: Fintech regulation is relatively mature (Fintech Law 21.521), with continued development of bank transfers and digital payment adoption. Online gambling is still in the legislative process, and a nationwide licensing framework has not yet been established.
🇵🇪 Peru: A regulated online gambling licensing framework has been established and is now in operational compliance. Digital payments and instant transfers continue to grow, with the industry gradually becoming more structured.
🇦🇷 Argentina: Gambling regulation operates under a provincial-level framework, resulting in a fragmented but active market. Digital wallets and local payment methods continue to expand amid foreign exchange controls and macroeconomic volatility.
We operate across all the above markets and welcome any inquiries.

Latin America iGaming Payment & Regulatory Structure Overview (2026):
🇧🇷 Brazil: PIX has become the core infrastructure for iGaming payments. Credit cards are gradually being phased out from deposit scenarios under regulatory restrictions, while oversight continues to strengthen compliance and taxation frameworks across the industry.
🇲🇽 Mexico: The iGaming market continues to grow steadily, but the regulatory framework remains fragmented. Local payments are still dominated by bank transfers and regional payment methods, resulting in significant structural differences across the market.
🇨🇴 Colombia: The iGaming regulatory system is relatively mature, with ongoing tightening of tax and compliance requirements. The industry is entering a phase of stable growth alongside improving operational efficiency.
